subject.statement: Pat Gelsinger is currently the CEO of Intel.

summary: Pat Gelsinger became Intel's CEO in February 2021 and there have been no credible reports of his departure or replacement up to late 2024/early 2025; thus as of 2026-10-01 he is still the CEO.
